settings.title: Notification settings
settings.intro: Choose each kind of notice separately. Task notices are independent of recommendations. Delivery is currently synthetic local capture only.
settings.unavailable: Notification settings are unavailable. Please sign in and try again.
settings.shared_device: I share this phone or device
settings.save_failed: Settings were not confirmed saved. Please try again.
quiet_hours.title: Quiet hours
quiet_hours.intro: Optional notices wait until quiet hours end. Urgent assistance notices may arrive during quiet hours.
print.title: Printable schedule
print.snapshot_warning: This copy reflects the source at that time. Later changes do not update or recall this printed copy. Check your current schedule before making plans.
print.open_authorized: Open a freshly authorized print view
print.browser_action: Use your browser’s Print command in the print view.
print.source_unavailable: No printable source is available. Please sign in and check again later.
print.no_source: No schedule sources are available yet. This is not confirmation that you have no upcoming plans.
print.empty: No items are recorded in this source snapshot.
body.minimal: You have a new notification. Sign in securely.
